CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Jacob Wrestles an Angel? (1 mark)
   A. Use Jacob Wrestles an Angel to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jacob Wrestles an Angel.
   C. Apply the teaching of Jacob Wrestles an Angel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Jacob Wrestles an Angel has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of My Purpose? (1 mark)
   A. Say My Purpose has no place in daily life.
   B. Use My Purpose to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of My Purpose with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Purpose.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of The Ten Commandments? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Ten Commandments.
   B. Use The Ten Commandments to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Ten Commandments with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The Ten Commandments has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Leisure? (1 mark)
   A. Use Leisure to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Leisure with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leisure.
   D. Say Leisure has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of The Call of Disciples? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Call of Disciples.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Call of Disciples with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Call of Disciples to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Call of Disciples has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Miracles of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracles of Jesus Christ.
   B. Use Miracles of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Miracles of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Miracles of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Faith in God Elisha? (1 mark)
   A. Use Faith in God Elisha to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Faith in God Elisha.
   C. Say Faith in God Elisha has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Faith in God Elisha with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Miracle of Healing? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracle of Healing.
   B. Use Miracle of Healing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Miracle of Healing has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Miracle of Healing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

11. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

12. Which response best shows understanding of Inspired Word of God? (1 mark)
   A. Say Inspired Word of God has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Inspired Word of God.
   C. Apply the teaching of Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Inspired Word of God to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Faith in God Elisha and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Jacob Wrestles an Angel and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Call of Disciples and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Temptations of Jesus Christ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
